review_scope: Technical review for private CPU execution of the unmodified canonical distributions, with original license grants and notices retained; not a redistribution legal opinion.
reviewed_terms: MIT: retain copyright and permission notice
BSD: retain copyright, conditions and disclaimers; non-endorsement where specified
Apache-2.0: retain license/NOTICE and patent terms; mark modifications if distributing
LGPL/GPL bundled notices: retain originals and source/relink obligations if distributing covered linked components
PSF, MPL, ISC and dual-licensed bundled components: preserve their original license and notice files
